submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset: a SINGLE native 1024 x 1024 RGBA transparent character animation frame, 02_fire_talisman_boy / cast / E / 03, an individual spell animation pose. Generate one full-body character only, not a sprite sheet.
References: Image 1 is the authoritative character identity and anatomical prop ownership: chestnut high ponytail, small gold crown with central red jewel, big amber eyes, bright red and gold flame-trimmed short Taoist robe, black trousers, ornate red-black-gold shoes, yin-yang waist medallion, five red rectangular talisman cards with gold flame motifs held like an open fan in the anatomical RIGHT hand; bronze ritual bell with red tassel in anatomical LEFT hand. Image 2 establishes strict right-facing E side-view camera and chibi proportions; it has ambiguous overlapping hands, so hand ownership MUST follow Image 1. Image 3 is the main established painting-quality/style reference only, ignore its UI and scene: bright clean rounded high-definition hand-painted Taoist chibi, warm subtle shading, soft dimensional forms, crisp readable silhouette.
Reference Image 4 is the newly generated release key for this exact character and camera: preserve identity, body proportions and rendered scale, but independently draw the different pose specified here.
Pose: Side view looking directly screen-right. Anatomical right shoulder/arm is camera-near and holds the FIVE red talisman cards; anatomical left is far and holds the bronze bell. Gathering power halfway. Compact shallow crouch, weight on rear foot screen-left while forward knee flexes. Near RIGHT elbow is bent close to ribs, five-card fan raised to collarbone just in front of cheek without blocking face. Far LEFT hand raises the bronze bell to chest height slightly behind body silhouette, handle visibly held. Shoulders turn only as much as natural side-facing casting, gaze right. Red tassels and robe lag gently from upward arm movement.
Camera/layout: fixed orthographic game-sprite camera matching side idle, no perspective zoom, full body and all props inside frame. 1024 x 1024 canvas, fixed invisible virtual ground y=920, root anchor (512,920), standing crown/hair top around y=145 and normal character height about 775 px; preserve this scale, do not crop or auto-fit around extremities. Real release motion may naturally bend knees a little. Face and hands high clarity.
Lighting/materials: warm soft painted highlights, restrained gold detail and red tassels exactly in the approved character style. No plastic gloss.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard painted in, no ground plane and no baked cast shadow.
Exclude: all detached particles, flames, glows, projectiles, motion trails, aura, text, labels, frame numbers, duplicate character, extra limbs/fingers/props. This is body animation only.
